palette: deep umber dye workshop, cream woven cloth cards, madder red and indigo threads, reed green bands, gold reeds
typography: WenKai weaving-loom headings with thread chips and cloth banners
composition: dual shuttle banks over a two-step note, weft rule bands with a no-escalation card beside an operation card, and four shelf cards under an effect band and mnemonic
surface: an indigo dye-loom workshop with warp-weft weave, cream cloth cards and thread accents
